versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν δὲ παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς πρὸς τὸ δεῖν πάντοτε προσεύχεσθαι αὐτοὺς καὶ μὴ ἐνκακεῖν,

controles.web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
controles.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes disse também uma parábola sobre o dever de sempre orar, e nunca se cansar.

versos.grego: λέγων Κριτής τις ἦν ἔν τινι πόλει τὸν Θεὸν μὴ φοβούμενος καὶ ἄνθρωπον μὴ ἐντρεπόμενος.

controles.web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.
controles.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
controles.livre: Dizendo: Havia um certo juiz em uma cidade, que não temia a Deus, nem respeitava pessoa alguma.

versos.grego: χήρα δὲ ἦν ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσα Ἐκδίκησόν με ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀντιδίκου μου.

controles.web: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
controles.kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
controles.livre: Havia também naquela mesma cidade uma certa viúva, e vinha até ele, dizendo: Faze-me justiça com meu adversário.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν ἐπὶ χρόνον· μετὰ ταῦτα δὲ εἶπεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ Εἰ καὶ τὸν Θεὸν οὐ φοβοῦμαι οὐδὲ ἄνθρωπον ἐντρέπομαι,

controles.web: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,
controles.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
controles.livre: E por um certo tempo ele não quis; mas depois disto, disse para si: Ainda que eu não tema a Deus, nem respeite pessoa alguma,

versos.grego: διά γε τὸ παρέχειν μοι κόπον τὴν χήραν ταύτην ἐκδικήσω αὐτήν, ἵνα μὴ εἰς τέλος ἐρχομένη ὑπωπιάζῃ με.

controles.web: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
controles.kjv: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
controles.livre: Porém, porque esta viúva me incomoda, eu lhe farei justiça, para que ela pare de vir me chatear.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Κύριος Ἀκούσατε τί ὁ κριτὴς τῆς ἀδικίας λέγει·

controles.web: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
controles.livre: E disse o Senhor: Ouvi o que diz o juiz injusto.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς οὐ μὴ ποιήσῃ τὴν ἐκδίκησιν τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν βοώντων αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός, καὶ μακροθυμεῖ ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς;

controles.web: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
controles.kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
controles.livre: E Deus não fará justiça para seus escolhidos, que clamam a ele de dia e de noite? Demorará com eles?

versos.grego: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ποιήσει τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αὐτῶν ἐν τάχει. πλὴν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐλθὼν ἆρα εὑρήσει τὴν πίστιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς;

controles.web: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
controles.kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
controles.livre: Digo-vos que depressa lhes fará justiça. Porém, quando o Filho do homem vier, por acaso ele achará fé na terra?

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ καὶ πρός τινας τοὺς πεποιθότας ἐφ’ ἑαυτοῖς ὅτι εἰσὶν δίκαιοι καὶ ἐξουθενοῦντας τοὺς λοιποὺς τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην.

controles.web: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.
controles.kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
controles.livre: E disse também a uns, que tinham confiança de si mesmos que eram justos, e desprezavam aos outros, esta parábola:

versos.grego: Ἄνθρωποι δύο ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσεύξασθαι, ὁ εἷς Φαρισαῖος καὶ ὁ ἕτερος τελώνης.

controles.web: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
controles.kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
controles.livre: Dois homens subiram ao Templo para orar, um fariseu, e o outro cobrador de impostos.

versos.grego: ὁ Φαρισαῖος σταθεὶς ταῦτα πρὸς ἑαυτὸν προσηύχετο Ὁ Θεός, εὐχαριστῶ σοι ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ ὥσπερ οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ἅρπαγες, ἄδικοι, μοιχοί, ἢ καὶ ὡς οὗτος ὁ τελώνης·

controles.web: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you, that I am not like the rest of men, extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
controles.kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
controles.livre: O fariseu, estando de pé, orava consigo desta maneira: Ó Deus, eu te agradeço, porque não sou como os outros homens, ladrões, injustos e adúlteros; nem sou como este cobrador de impostos.

versos.grego: νηστεύω δὶς τοῦ σαββάτου, ἀποδεκατεύω πάντα ὅσα κτῶμαι.

controles.web: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
controles.kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
controles.livre: Jejuo duas vezes por semana, e dou dízimo de tudo quanto possuo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ τελώνης μακρόθεν ἑστὼς οὐκ ἤθελεν οὐδὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐπᾶραι εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν, ἀλλ’ ἔτυπτεν τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ λέγων Ὁ Θεός, ἱλάσθητί μοι τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ.

controles.web: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
controles.kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
controles.livre: E o cobrador de impostos, estando em pé de longe, nem mesmo queria levantar os olhos ao céu, mas batia em seu peito, dizendo: Ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim, que sou pecador.

versos.grego: λέγω ὑμῖν, κατέβη οὗτος δεδικαιωμένος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ παρ’ ἐκεῖνον· ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται, ὁ δὲ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.

controles.web: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
controles.kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
controles.livre: Digo-vos que este desceu mais justificado à sua casa do que aquele outro; porque qualquer que a si mesmo se exalta, será humilhado; e qualquer que a si mesmo se humilha, será exaltado.

versos.grego: Προσέφερον δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ τὰ βρέφη ἵνα αὐτῶν ἅπτηται· ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
controles.kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
controles.livre: E traziam-lhe também crianças pequenas, para que as tocasse; e os discípulos, vendo, os repreendiam.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσεκαλέσατο αὐτὰ λέγων Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά· τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
controles.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus, chamando-lhes para si, disse: Deixai as crianças virem a mim, e não as impeçais; porque das tais é o Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν.

controles.web: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo, que qualquer que não receber o Reino de Deus como criança, não entrará nele.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησέν τις αὐτὸν ἄρχων λέγων Διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ, τί ποιήσας ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

controles.web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
controles.kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
controles.livre: E um certo líder lhe perguntou, dizendo: Bom mestre, o que tenho que fazer para herdar a vida eterna?

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τί με λέγεις ἀγαθόν; οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one—God.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe disse: Por que me chamas de bom? Ninguém é bom, a não ser um: Deus.

versos.grego: τὰς ἐντολὰς οἶδας Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς, Μὴ φονεύσῃς, Μὴ κλέψῃς, Μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς, Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα.

controles.web: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
controles.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
controles.livre: Tu sabes os mandamentos: não adulterarás, não matarás, não furtarás, não darás falso testemunho, honra a teu pai e a tua mãe.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα ἐκ νεότητος.

controles.web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
controles.kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Todas estas coisas tenho guardado desde minha juventude.

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἔτι ἕν σοι λείπει· πάντα ὅσα ἔχεις πώλησον καὶ διάδος πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

controles.web: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.”
controles.kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
controles.livre: Porém Jesus, ouvindo isto, disse-lhe: Ainda uma coisa te falta: vende tudo quanto tens, e reparte-o entre os pobres, e terás um tesouro no céu; e vem, segue-me.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀκούσας ταῦτα περίλυπος ἐγενήθη, ἦν γὰρ πλούσιος σφόδρα.

controles.web: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
controles.kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
controles.livre: Mas ele, ouvindo isto, ficou muito triste, porque era muito rico.

versos.grego: ἰδὼν δὲ αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ τὰ χρήματα ἔχοντες εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσπορεύονται·

controles.web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!
controles.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
controles.livre: E vendo Jesus que ele tinha ficado muito triste, disse: Como é difícil os que têm muitos bens entrarem no Reino de Deus!

versos.grego: εὐκοπώτερον γάρ ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρήματος βελόνης εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν.

controles.web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Porque é mais fácil um camelo entrar pelo olho de uma agulha do que um rico entrar no Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: εἶπαν δὲ οἱ ἀκούσαντες Καὶ τίς δύναται σωθῆναι;

controles.web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
controles.kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
controles.livre: E os que ouviram isto ,disseram: Quem então pode se salvar?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Τὰ ἀδύνατα παρὰ ἀνθρώποις δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ ἐστιν.

controles.web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
controles.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
controles.livre: E ele disse: As coisas que são impossíveis para os seres humanos são possíveis para Deus.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφέντες τὰ ἴδια ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι.

controles.web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything, and followed you.”
controles.kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
controles.livre: E Pedro disse: Eis que deixamos tudo, e temos te seguido.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδείς ἐστιν ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ γονεῖς ἢ τέκνα ἕνεκεν τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the Kingdom of God’s sake,
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Em verdade vos digo, que há ninguém que, tenha deixado casa, ou pais, ou irmãos, ou mulher, ou filhos,

versos.grego: ὃς οὐχὶ μὴ λάβῃ πολλαπλασίονα ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
controles.kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
controles.livre: Que não venha a receber de volta muito mais nestes tempos, e nos tempos vindouros receba a vida eterna.

versos.grego: Παραλαβὼν δὲ τοὺς δώδεκα εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ, καὶ τελεσθήσεται πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα διὰ τῶν προφητῶν τῷ Υἱῷ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου·

controles.web: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
controles.kjv: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
controles.livre: E tomando consigo aos doze, disse-lhes: Eis que estamos subindo a Jerusalém, e se cumprirá no Filho do homem tudo o que está escrito pelos profetas.

versos.grego: παραδοθήσεται γὰρ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐμπαιχθήσεται καὶ ὑβρισθήσεται καὶ ἐμπτυσθήσεται,

controles.web: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
controles.kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
controles.livre: Porque ele será entregue aos gentios, e escarnecido, injuriado e cuspido.

versos.grego: καὶ μαστιγώσαντες ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν, καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἀναστήσεται.

controles.web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
controles.kjv: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
controles.livre: E depois de açoitá-lo, o matarão; e ao terceiro dia ressuscitará.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐδὲν τούτων συνῆκαν, καὶ ἦν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο κεκρυμμένον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον τὰ λεγόμενα.

controles.web: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
controles.kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
controles.livre: E eles nada entendiam destas coisas; e esta palavra lhes era oculta; e não entendiam o que estava sendo lhes dito.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱερειχὼ τυφλός τις ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἐπαιτῶν.

controles.web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
controles.livre: E aconteceu que ele, chegando perto de Jericó, estava um cego sentado junto ao caminho, mendigando.

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ ὄχλου διαπορευομένου ἐπυνθάνετο τί εἴη τοῦτο.

controles.web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
controles.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
controles.livre: E este, ouvindo a multidão passar, perguntou: O que era aquilo?

versos.grego: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος παρέρχεται.

controles.web: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
controles.kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
controles.livre: E disseram-lhe que Jesus Nazareno estava passando.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐβόησεν λέγων Ἰησοῦ υἱὲ Δαυείδ, ἐλέησόν με.

controles.web: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
controles.kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
controles.livre: Então clamou, dizendo: Jesus, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim!

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ προάγοντες ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ ἵνα σιγήσῃ· αὐτὸς δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν Υἱὲ Δαυείδ, ἐλέησόν με.

controles.web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
controles.kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
controles.livre: E os que estavam mais a frente o repreendiam, para que calasse; porém ele clamava ainda mais: Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim!

versos.grego: σταθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ἀχθῆναι πρὸς αὐτόν. ἐγγίσαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν

controles.web: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
controles.kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
controles.livre: Então Jesus, parando, mandou que o trouxessem para si; e chegando ele, perguntou-lhe,

versos.grego: Τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Κύριε, ἵνα ἀναβλέψω.

controles.web: “What do you want me to do?”   He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
controles.kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
controles.livre: Dizendo: Que queres que eu te faça?E ele disse: Senhor, que eu veja.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀνάβλεψον· ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe disse: Vê, tua fé te salvou.

versos.grego: καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνέβλεψεν, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ δοξάζων τὸν Θεόν. καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἰδὼν ἔδωκεν αἶνον τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
controles.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
controles.livre: E logo ele viu, e o seguia, glorificando a Deus. E o todo o povo, vendo isto ,dava louvores a Deus.
